title: Dacoit: A Love Story
plot_overview: After being betrayed by someone he loves, a man is convicted of a crime he did not commit. When he is free again, he sets out to find her and seek revenge, while their lives become entangled with a series of robberies.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like stories that mix romance, revenge, and crime; Not for you if you prefer plots without betrayal or a pursuit of vengeance.
review_summary: Pros: betrayal-driven premise; romance and revenge; robbery-related intrigue | Cons: few story details; no review feedback; tone is unclear
